title: Contract extraction
description: What the agent reads out of ONE contract. The agent only extracts and cites; every determination (tier, band, outlier, category) is computed by code from the rulebook.

file_name.description: PDF file name the text came from.

agreement_id.description: Agreement ID as printed IN the document (used to catch a wrong PDF filed under a row).

annual_commitments.description: Committed spend per contract year, in order. Empty if none.

term_commitment.description: A separate whole-term commitment, only if the contract states one.

evidence.description: Field name -> 'Section X, p.N: "quoted clause"'. Required for every non-null key value.

uncertain.description: Anything the agent could not determine with confidence. Never guess - flag here instead.

observations.description: Short plain-English observations for the summary paragraph.
